notes.title: New game modes
notes.notes:
We added new game modes to Pooplers ! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36310636/707fd94f7f0b9ad9c7c14b5e64d726cd369e7204.jpg[/img]
Do you like football? That's great, you will be able to play it in our game as well! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36310636/3473c07d3aa9ac4612f589ab60d56cc5648056af.jpg[/img]
Fight the zombie horde using your balloon weapon in CO-OP game mode. Protect your candy's.
